data.title: 常陆茉子 · 把桨上的沙冲干净
data.description: 茉子在溪边把租来的短桨举起来，顺着桨叶浇下一勺清水。砂粒被冲进石缝，钩在桨柄上的收绳也跟着晃了一下。
data.location: 溪畔的浅滩和划艇归还处
data.action: 举起短桨，用一勺水冲掉附着的沙粒
data.lighting: 碎光透过树叶照亮溪水和桨面
data.camera: 岸边平视全身，足部和桨叶入镜
data.promptProse: Mako rinses a short paddle at the creekside return rack, tipping a scoop of clear water over the blade. The cropped mesh hoodie lies above her forest-green swimsuit. Both feet are steady on flat pebbles as the paddle strap swings free.
data.animaCaption: Her free hand pours a narrow ribbon of water down the blade while the strap swings beneath the grip.
